Class ServerContext

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server.ServerContext
public final class ServerContext extends Object
The shared state a ToolHandler executes against: the lazily-built SDK facades (Fabric + design engines, Customer Portal, Network Edge, IBX SmartView), the environment, the JSON mapper, and the single-process PlanStore.

Facades are created on first use, per facade, so a server launched with only the ibx toolset never constructs a Customer Portal client. All facades vend from one Equinix session (one OAuth token, one connection pool) when the context was built from a session or credentials; alternatively each facade can be injected directly — that is how tests supply Mockito-stubbed facades, and how embedders can reuse clients they already hold.

This type is part of the public tool seam: broker/extension tools registered through ToolRegistration receive the same context instance as the built-in catalog.

    • providerRateCard

      public Optional<RateCard> providerRateCard(CloudProviderType provider)
      Returns the live pricing adapter for a cloud provider, if one can be constructed (GCP requires ENV_GCP_BILLING_KEY). The adapter is built once per provider and reused for the context's lifetime, so its internal offer/SKU catalogue caches actually pay off across tool calls. The returned card is not yet timeout-guarded — design_compare_cloud_egress wraps it per invocation.
      Parameters:
      provider - the cloud provider
      Returns:
      the live rate card, or empty when no adapter is available for the provider

    • currentExchange

      public io.modelcontextprotocol.server.McpSyncServerExchange currentExchange()
      The MCP client exchange bound for the current tool call, or null when the handler is running outside a served call (a direct unit-test invocation, or a transport that supplied none). A handler that wants to prompt the user reads this and hands it to ElicitationSupport; a null exchange means "no interactive client", and the elicitation degrades cleanly.
      Returns:
      the current call's exchange, or null
